moments.text: Grey-scale infrared view with a centre crosshair, looking down on a rippled grey surface. Black boxes hide the edges of the display.
A small bright spot enters at the bottom edge and climbs quickly up the right side of the frame, leaving at the top edge.
The spot drops back in at the top right and slides down the right side, vanishing at the top of the lower-right black box.
It reappears at the bottom edge left of that box, sweeps up to the upper left, then drifts in toward the crosshair.
The sensor holds the small bright spot near the crosshair, mostly just below and left of it.
A larger dark smudge with a faint trail enters at the left edge, passes the bright spot and the crosshair, and slides into the lower-right black box.
The picture flashes white and breaks into blocks, then returns flat grey with less contrast; the bright spot sits right of the crosshair.
In the flatter picture the spot is faint, wandering left of and below the crosshair; it is hard to see after about 4:04.
